printer.notes: Brother HL-L3300CDW is a 600 DPI native color laser engine fed short-edge. Landscape scores are rotated 90 degrees via pdftops -paper letter to fit perfectly on the 8.5 x 11 in sheet with uniform 6mm side margins and no corner clipping. Do NOT pass PJL ORIENTATION=LANDSCAPE or RESOLUTION=1200 as they conflict with PostScript setpagedevice rotation.
